Janet Lipson, Chair  Erin Hoops, Member
Steve Askin, Vice Chair  Joseph Hower, Member
Ismar Enriquez, Member  Ethel Powers, Member

Angel Arredondo, Bureau Manager  Nicholas Masero, Deputy City Attorney
Myeesha Ayala, Secretary  Scott Baldwin, Acting Code Enforcement Officer

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  LBCD@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56082  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Board of Examiners, Appeals and
  Condemnation meeting of Monday, July 21, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56081  Recommendation to conclude the hearing, determine that the cited party is the
  current owner and responsible party of the subject property located at 3606 Falcon
  Avenue, Long Beach, California, and the violations listed did exist on the date the
  citation was issued.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56091  Recommendation to support the proposed amendments to Title 18 of the Long
  Beach Municipal Code related to the 2025 Edition of the California Building
  Standards Code and the 1997 Edition of the Uniform Housing Code and forward to
  City Council for their recommendation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56157  Recommendation to receive and file Manager’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT
